full_prompt_en: A square photographic portrait fills the frame with the face of a gray dog, viewed from very close and slightly below the level of its eyes. The background is a smooth charcoal gray field that darkens subtly toward the corners and leaves no visible setting. Both floppy ears extend toward the side edges, their fine pale hairs catching soft light against the darker space. The head sits centered, with a narrow gray forehead and two very round eyes looking straight into the lens. Bright white catchlights sit high inside the dark pupils, and thin warm rings separate the eyes from the surrounding gray fur. The broad black nose projects toward the viewer and occupies much of the lower center. Its pebbled surface and small glossy highlights are sharply resolved, while the snout behind it falls away more softly. Light gray hairs scatter across the bridge of the nose and cheeks, mixing with darker charcoal strands. Long fine whiskers cross the shadow near the lower sides, and only a small portion of the neck remains visible at the bottom edge. The close lens makes the nearest nose disproportionately large and pushes the ears outward, giving the otherwise calm dog an alert, comic expression. Soft frontal light from slightly above illuminates the brow, cheeks and nose texture without casting a hard shadow. The edges of the face and the background recede into deep gray, while the eyes and central nose retain the strongest definition. The image is almost monochrome, though warm brown flecks around the eyes give a little color to the cool fur. The overall composition is simple and intimate, with exaggerated near-camera scale and small bright reflections turning a direct gaze into a playful studio portrait.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形摄影肖像从极近距离、略低于眼睛的位置拍摄一只灰色狗，脸几乎填满画面。背景是平滑的炭灰色域，朝四角微微加深，没有可见场景。两只下垂耳朵向侧边缘伸展，细浅毛在较深空间前接住柔光。头部居中，狭窄灰额头下，两只很圆的眼睛直望镜头。深色瞳孔上方有明亮白反光，细暖色眼圈把眼睛与周围灰毛分开。宽大的黑鼻子向观者凸出，占去下方中央大部分。颗粒状鼻面与细小光亮点清晰可辨，后面的口鼻则柔和退去。浅灰毛丝散在鼻梁和脸颊，与更深的炭色毛交织。长而细的胡须越过两侧下方的阴影，底边只露出少量颈部。近距离镜头把最近的鼻子放大得不成比例，并把耳朵推向外侧，让原本平静的狗显出警觉而滑稽的神情。略从上方来的柔和正面光照亮眉、颊和鼻面肌理，没有硬投影。面部边缘与背景退入深灰，双眼及中央鼻子保留最强清晰度。图像几乎单色，但眼周暖褐细点给冷灰毛发添少量颜色。整体构图简洁亲近，靠近镜头的夸张尺度和小亮反光把直视变成俏皮的影棚肖像。
style_prompt_en: The image has a close photographic finish with a deliberate near-lens scale exaggeration and shallow background. Cool charcoal and silver gray dominate, while tiny warm flecks and bright specular points concentrate near the focal center. Fine fibrous texture is sharply resolved at selected surfaces, and smooth dark negative space falls away toward the corners. Soft frontal light from slightly above reveals surface detail without hard cast shadows. The nearest form projects strongly forward and becomes larger than surrounding features, creating playful dimensional tension within a simple centered composition. Edge softness increases away from the central plane, yet a few small highlights remain crisp. The overall treatment is intimate and humorous, with restrained color and selective clarity giving a direct, almost tactile presence.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有近距离摄影完成面，有意夸大的近镜头尺度和浅背景并存。冷炭灰与银灰色占主导，极少量暖斑和明亮镜面点集中在焦点中央。所选表面的细纤维肌理清楚可辨，平滑深色负空间向四角退去。略从上方来的柔和正面光显示表面细节，没有硬投影。最近的形体强烈向前凸出，尺度大于周围特征，在简洁居中的构图里形成俏皮的体积张力。离开中央平面后边缘更柔，但几处小高光仍锐利。整体处理亲近而幽默，克制色彩与选择性清晰带来几乎可触的直接存在感。
theme_en: An extreme close-up portrait of a gray dog with wide eyes and an enlarged nose
theme_zh: 一只灰色狗的极近景肖像，双眼圆睁，鼻子被放大
name: Elke Vogelsang
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
